core_strategy.title: Core Strategy
core_strategy.intro: Our strategy addresses the demands of the real estate market. We reimagine the development and management of multi-family residential buildings in the U.S. by focusing on:
core_strategy.point_1_body: Top-tier architects, engineers, and contractors focused on innovation and quality.
core_strategy.point_2_body: Management techniques to optimize timelines, control costs, and ensure excellence.
core_strategy.point_3_body: Executing each project with balanced budgeting, resources, and timelines to guarantee quality standards and financial returns.

investment_options.title: Investment Options
investment_options.point_1_body: Ownership in projects, with gains from appreciation, rental income, and future sales profits.
investment_options.point_2_body: For those seeking fixed returns, offering predictable income backed by real estate assets.

performance_goals.title: Performance Goals
performance_goals.point_1_body: Our projects are structured to deliver strong, above-market returns for our investors. Every opportunity is carefully underwritten to maximize value and minimize risk. Contact us to learn more about projected returns on current offerings.
performance_goals.point_2_body: Each project is executed with a clear timeline, disciplined milestone tracking, and an unwavering commitment to on-time delivery and quality. Reach out to discuss the timeline and scope of our active projects.
performance_goals.point_3_body: Strategic planning and active oversight are embedded in every phase of our projects — from acquisition through delivery — ensuring predictable outcomes and the protection of investor capital. Contact us to understand how we safeguard your investment.

pillars.title: Our Pillars
pillars.mission_description: Prosperum's mission is to deliver attractive, risk-adjusted returns for investors through strategic real estate development.
pillars.strategy_description: The company focuses on transforming underutilized assets into high-performing properties, with an emphasis on value creation, sustainability, and long-term growth.
pillars.principles_description: Our principles are: value creation, sustainability, and long-term growth, with strong collaboration between partners to ensure projects that meet investor expectations.

why_invest.title: Why Invest with Prosperum?

why_invest.expertise_description: Our team consists of industry veterans with decades of experience in real estate investment, development, and construction. We bring a wealth of knowledge and a track record of success to every project.
why_invest.track_record_description: With multiple successful projects completed and in the pipeline, Prosperum has consistently delivered on its promises, achieving strong returns for its investors.
why_invest.quality_description: From design to execution, we ensure that every project meets the highest standards of quality, durability, and sustainability. This commitment enhances the value of our properties and ensures long-term profitability for our investors.
why_invest.communication_description: We provide regular, detailed reports and updates on each project, ensuring that our investors are always informed and can make decisions with confidence.

schubert-ln.description:
Schubert Lane has been completely repaved, setting the stage for one of the most distinguished addresses in Bergen County. Nestled on one of the most private and sought-after streets in highly desirable Paramus, NJ, this rare half-acre lot — approximately 100 x 200 feet — presents an exceptional opportunity for discerning buyers and investors alike.

Forca Builders brings fully signed and sealed, shovel-ready architectural drawings for a one-of-a-kind custom home complete with a private pool — eliminating the lengthy design and approval process that typically accompanies a project of this caliber. Buyers may move forward with the existing plans or collaborate with Forca Builders to customize the design to their personal vision.

Prosperum Investment Group proudly presents this offering as part of its curated portfolio of premium development opportunities in one of New Jersey's most consistently appreciating markets — where vision, location, and execution converge.
highlights: Shovel-ready architectural drawings, signed and sealed
Rare half-acre lot — approx. 100 x 200 ft in Paramus
Custom home with private pool — fully customizable
Prime Bergen County development opportunity

hero.title: Who We Are
hero.subtitle: We are a team of real estate professionals dedicated to creating lasting value through strategic investment and development across the United States.

partners.p1_bio: Jean Nunes is a construction and real estate operator specializing in value-add residential development, multifamily opportunities, and integrated construction management. Through Força Builders and Prosperum Investment Partners, Jean oversees projects from acquisition and planning through construction execution and operational delivery. His background in mechanical systems, renovations, and project operations provides a practical advantage in cost control, execution speed, and asset optimization.
partners.p2_bio: Wendel Fernandes is a builder, developer, and entrepreneur leading a group of companies focused on luxury homes, real estate development, and high-end construction across New Jersey and New York. His companies specialize in custom homes, multifamily projects, and premium interior finishes, offering a complete approach from development and sourcing to construction and installation. Known for being hands-on in every project, Wendel focuses on quality workmanship, modern design, and building properties with long-term value for both homeowners and investors.
partners.p3_bio: Armando Fejzaj is a real estate developer and investor focused on multifamily, residential, and commercial development projects throughout New York and New Jersey. Through Elar Group, he leads the acquisition, development, and repositioning of properties with an emphasis on strategic growth, modern design, and efficient project execution. His approach combines development vision, market insight, and construction expertise to deliver high-quality assets that create long-term value, strong market presence, and attractive investment returns. At Prosperum, his focus is on identifying unique opportunities and executing thoughtfully designed projects that deliver exceptional quality, operational excellence, and lasting value for investors.
partners.p4_bio: Jhuly Soares is a real estate agent specializing in acquisitions and sales of high-end residential properties across New Jersey and New York. As part of the Prosperum group, she leads the buying and selling strategy for the company's luxury and alto padrão projects, connecting discerning clients with properties that reflect quality, design, and long-term value. Known for her attention to detail and deep understanding of the luxury market, Jhuly brings a personalized approach to every transaction — ensuring both homeowners and investors find exactly what they are looking for.
